name: Bounty Hunter
text: Takes posted bounties over open adventuring and is quicker to finish them.

benefits.text: Bounties claimed by this hero pay a tenth more, and marked targets cannot hide from them under fog.

name: Tavern Regular
text: Everyone at the bar knows this hero's name.

benefits.text: Hears rumors first and recovers from bad moods in one night at the tavern.

name: Town Hero
prerequisite: Saved the town in a siege
text: Songs are sung about this hero.

benefits.text: While in town, raises the renown of every hero who adventures with them, and recruits come from further away.
